items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station or drink any Nuka-Cola variant

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your shelter and place any decoration from the build menu

items.title: Collect a Teddy Bear
items.detail: Northeast of Knife Edge; use grenade to knock bears down from ledge

items.title: Eat a Cooked Meal
items.detail: Cook at any cooking station or buy from Mr/Ms Waiter at Whitespring

items.title: Kill a Festive Scorched
items.detail: Only during Holiday Scorched event; spawns at Wavy Willard's Water Park

items.title: Kill a Honey Beast
items.detail: Fast travel to Middle Mountain Pitstop for reliable spawn

items.title: Kill a Radhog
items.detail: Head southwest from Ash Cave fast travel point near windmill

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies with energy weapons

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Use Games Cupboard at C.A.M.P. to produce board games

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns; tag weak spots with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has reliable robot spawns of all types

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild locations or plant vegetables at C.A.M.P. for on-demand gathering

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Only appears at Head Hunt event during Slasher seasonal event; join or start from Highway Town bounty board

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Buy from Whitespring dining area or find at Pumpkin House, then sell to any vendor

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon or craft cheap grenades to sell

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to a player C.A.M.P. with shelter access via map radiation symbol
